messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — we need to align the API/runtime/console/SDK versions before next-day cutoff. Cutoff is Mon 22:00 UTC, please avoid merging after that unless it's an emergency.
Samir: API side: opened PR https://git.redwood.ai/api/pull/1234, version -> 4.2.0, changelog added under docs/changelog/4.2.0.md. Ran unit + integration locally, looks good but want runtime smoke before final merge.
Olga: Runtime PR https://git.redwood.ai/runtime/pull/987 bumped runtime to 2.3.1. Failing `kv_cache_tests::eviction` on linux-x86 CI, investigating. If that's flaky, I can queue a rebuild — ETA 45m.
DeployBot: Canary started for runtime 2.3.1-rc on pool-d, job #7845. Monitoring logs.
Maya: @Olga thanks — if the KV test is a flake, mark the PR as `ci:rebuild` and ping here. We can't leave API merged without a compatible runtime.
Jordan: Console change is small (ui:release-note-link). PR https://git.redwood.ai/console/pull/555, version 1.11.0. Waiting on design sign-off (Anna), but can land after that. ETA 2h.
Ryan: SDKs: node v0.8.4 and python v0.8.4 ready. Publishing blocked by expired PyPI token — I filed infra ticket #312 and pinged infra. Might be 3-4h.
Samir: If SDK publish is delayed we should still push API + runtime, but tag them with `no-sdk` in the release notes and hold the release draft. Thoughts?
Maya: prefer to keep a single consistent release. If SDKs aren't out before cutoff, we do a soft-lock and push a hotfix release after tokens are fixed.
Olga: CI rebuild passed on second run, failure looked transient. I pushed a commit to runtime branch with a test timeout tweak. PR now green.
DeployBot: Canary passed for runtime 2.3.1-rc after 40m. No error spikes.
Samir: API PR merged. Tagged `api/v4.2.0` and created release draft.
Jordan: Console PR merged with design OK. Tagged `console/v1.11.0`.
Ryan: infra fixed the PyPI token; SDKs publishing in progress. Node done, Python publishing queued.
Maya: great. Quick checklist before final release: 1) confirm tags for all repos, 2) changelog entries linked in release notes, 3) canary health OK (runtime), 4) SDKs published. Reply with :thumbsup: when done.
Samir: tag + release draft done :thumbsup:
Olga: canary ok, runtime tag pushed :thumbsup:
Jordan: console release note linked :thumbsup:
Ryan: SDKs published (node + python) :shipit:
Maya: merging release draft into prod tomorrow at 09:00 UTC unless anyone raises a last-minute issue. If you need a freeze extension, call it out here before 21:30 UTC.
Samir: noted, thanks all.
